title: CS daily scratchpad - QBRs + renewals + follow-ups
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick notes, reminders, and action items for accounts (QBR prep, renewals, support follow-ups)

TL;DR
- Prioritize Epsilon QBR prep (meeting Wed 7/08) - finish slides, bring usage + cost delta, highlight latency improvements from 6/1 infra change.
- Follow up with Gamma on renewal terms - CS rep call scheduled 7/09; need updated pricing scenario and exec summary.
- Knock out support open tickets that are blocking onboarding for Orion.

Morning checklist (start of day)
- [ ] Sync with Jordan 10:00am (30m) - QBR slide review and who owns which talking points
- [ ] Check alerts for high-latency tails on EU region (ticketed if >3% p95 spikes)
- [ ] Quick ping to Solutions ENG for Epsilon throughput graph (ask for per-model breakdown)

Epsilon QBR (Wed 7/08) - notes + prep
- Attendees: Epsilon: Sarah K., Dev lead; Redwood: Amelia (CS), Jordan (solutions), Miguel (account exec)
- Objectives: renew at current seat level + get approval for pilot of dedicated capacity in Q4; address cost spikes seen in May
- Data we need: monthly token usage (Mar- Jun), per-route latency, cache hit rate changes after 6/1 patch, examples of customer prompts that triggered high cost (redacted)
- Slides to finalize: 1) Exec summary (1 slide) 2) Usage trends + cost breakdown (2 slides) 3) Performance wins (1 slide) 4) Proposed Dedicated pilot + pricing scenarios (2 slides) 5) Ask / next steps (1 slide)
- Who owns what: Jordan = performance slides + graphs; me = Exec summary + renewal ask; Miguel = pricing + contract terms
- Open questions: do we have running ROIs for dedicated pilot? If not, ask pricing ops for a ballpark by EOD Tue

Gamma renewal (7/09 call)
- Current contract expires 9/30. Renewal discussion needs to start now. Gamma has been stable but heavy embedding costs last quarter.
- Tasks: compile last 6 months embedding usage, propose 10% committed discount for 12-month renewal, list recommendations (batching embeddings, model quantization)
- Draft outreach: "Hi Marco - wanted to share draft renewal scenarios ahead of our call on 7/09. Attached: usage summary + recommended optimizations. Can you confirm decision-makers joining the call?"

Orion onboarding blockers (support)
- Ticket #CS-1128: model load failures on dev cluster (assigned to infra, priority P1). Notes: error thrown after model quantization build; request stack trace from infra; ask release-eng to revert if no fix by EOD
- Ticket #CS-1150: SSO mapping inconsistent for two users - workaround: invite as external until idp fix; need clear timeline from security team
- Action: escalate both in Slack channel #sre-urgent if no response in 2 hours

Outreach / follow-ups (quick list)
- [ ] Email Epsilon exec summary draft to Sarah by EOD Tue (7/07)
- [ ] Post QBR slide deck to Confluence page and share link with attendees
- [ ] Create renewal scenario doc for Gamma (3 scenarios: renew same, committed discount, dedicated pilot) - attach to JIRA JIRA-CS-1023
- [ ] Close support ticket notes for Orion after infra reply
- [ ] Check-in with Lina (security) re: SSO mapping ETA

Notes to self / reminders
- When presenting performance wins, call out specific improvements from 6/1 kernel selection change (p95 down ~18% for small models). Keep it concrete: numbers + short example request/response time.
- Keep pricing ask simple on slides: two options (standard renew + pilot with 20% uplift) - talk through value props, not engineering details.
- Ask for 30-day pilot MOU for dedicated capacity rather than long-term commit to reduce friction.

Meeting minutes template (quick)
- Date: 
- Attendees: 
- Key decisions: 
- Action items (owner, due date): 

End-of-day quick log
- 5:00pm - send updated slides to Jordan and Miguel
- 5:30pm - log completed items in CRM (Gainsight/JIRA)

Random misc links
- Usage dashboard (internal): https://metrics.redwood.ai/dashboards/account-usage/epsilon
- Confluence QBR template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/CS-QBR-template

Questions / unknowns to research
- Does pricing ops need a formal request for ROI calc or can we get a quick ballpark? (ask Miguel)
- Any legal flags on a 30-day pilot MOU? (loop in Legal if Miguel says yes)

-----
Scratchpad end.

(Notes are rough, may be copy-pasted into a better doc for the actual QBR deck and renewal proposal. Leave here as authoritative action list until final deck posted.)
